scope: Diagnostic-only target overlay; unchanged candidate application JAR; probes arm after graphics warmup. Thread CPU/body elapsed clocks exclude their own begin/end accounting I/O. Root scopes include nested body accounting. Host counters bracket body plus accounting probes; counter gaps alone do not prove a driver cause. JFR whitelist excludes environment, system properties, process lists and heap content. No recorder. This instrumented run is not a matched performance trial.

scopeManifest.observer: Diagnostic-only OwnerTrace and World terrain-scope overlays; getrusage counters, selected GC/wait JFR events; no procfs/perf-bean probes or video; not qualification frame measurements

limits: JFR/trace observer changes timings; separate unrecorded matched trials establish performance.
Some low-CPU wall gaps have no matching Java wait or GC event and remain unattributed; no physical-driver cause is claimed.
Host counters bracket extra probe I/O and can exceed the timed body interval.
lighting.pump/mesh.upload units are their allowed byte budgets, not transferred bytes; mesh.allocate and gl.pixels3D report actual store/copy bytes.
counterMode: Linux64 own-thread getrusage snapshots; procfs/perf-bean probes disabled; allocation and GC-count columns unmeasured; JFR provides GC overlaps
